Audit Question: Are pilot losses defined consistently and ranked?
Are cleaning lubrication guarding leaks and obvious defects controlled?
Do operators complete defined safe checks and escalate abnormalities?
Do PM tasks address documented failure modes and use justified intervals?
Are defect-producing equipment conditions defined and monitored?
Are assigned tasks matched to current qualifications and training?
Are task boundaries hazards and controls explicit?
Are recurring losses assigned with root cause countermeasure and verification?
Are job plans tools permits and parts ready before scheduled work?
Does the weekly review update standards priorities and ownership?
